annotations.title: Store the Bing Webmaster API key

description: Tests the Bing Webmaster Tools API key against Bing (GetUserSites) and, only if Bing accepts it, stores it for the Organiq account (one key per account; it serves every property with a Bing site set by set_bing_site). The key is generated by the user in Bing Webmaster Tools under Settings → API access ("Configurações → Acesso à API") and pasted in the chat; it is stored encrypted, never returned by any tool and not logged. Format: 16–128 letters, digits, "-" or "_". Bing refuses the key → bing_key_invalid and the previously stored key, if any, stays; Bing down or slow → upstream_unavailable and nothing is stored (retry in a few minutes). Only an owner or admin of the account can store it (insufficient_scope otherwise). Returns { set, setAt, bingSites }: bingSites are the site URLs Bing lists for the key, to check the value given to set_bing_site. Needs the write scope (mcp:write). Use it after set_bing_site, or when get_bing_performance / check_connection report the key missing. Guide: https://organiqgeo.com/connect/bing. / Testa a chave da API do Bing no próprio Bing e só grava, cifrada, se ele aceitar; chave recusada não substitui a anterior.

key.description: API key generated in Bing Webmaster Tools (Settings → API access) and pasted by the user.
